purpose.title: Burkett Studios — Digital products we own
purpose.description: Burkett Studios is the digital-product arm of Burkett Investments. A map of products we build, run, and own, with links to each product site.
purpose.heroLede: Burkett Studios is the arm of Burkett Investments that builds, runs, and owns our digital products. This site is the map: what we hold, and where each product lives online.

products.name: Year Wall
products.oneLiner: Your whole year on one screen.
products.card: Dense year wall, continuous plan bars, household cloud. Not a day-list calendar.
products.lede: Year Wall is a Burkett-owned calendar product: the full year visible at once, continuous plan bars, web and iPhone.
bullets: Whole-year wall with continuous plan bars
Household cloud across web and iPhone
Web live; iOS when quality clears the bar

products.name: Wandered
products.card: Exact coastlines, trip journal, passport that fills as you travel.
products.lede: Wandered is a Burkett-owned travel map product: where you have been, painted with real precision, plus trips and a passport.
bullets: Marketing site and app are both on wandered.burkettinv.com

products.name: SurroStack
products.oneLiner: Ops stack for a high-stakes personal journey.
products.card: Tasks, calendar, money, and share status for surrogacy logistics.
products.lede: SurroStack is a Burkett-owned operations product for surrogacy journeys. The live product is a signed-in portal; this page is the public pointer.
bullets: Task portal and calendar for journey load
Share Status for partners and support
No separate public marketing domain yet
products.note: Public marketing site not launched. Use the portal link if you have access.

products.name: MassageNow
products.card: Nashville pilot marketplace for same-day massage inventory.
products.lede: MassageNow is a Burkett-owned marketplace product. Story and waitlist live on getmassagenow.com.
products.waitlistNote: Prefer the product site when it is open; or leave an email below.

products.name: Orient
products.card: Local orientation without SEO directory sludge. Region pilots first.
products.lede: Orient is a Burkett-owned place-guide product in seed. No public product site yet.
bullets: Waitlist until a product site ships

products.name: Conflict Patterns
products.oneLiner: Private pattern tracking for hard conversations.
products.card: Research-backed personal software. Privacy first. Still in design.
products.lede: Conflict Patterns is a Burkett-owned personal product in seed. No public product site yet.
